description: Create an integer array [10, 20, 30, 40] with the GREEN style, add index labels below, and fade it in with FadeIn.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_dsa import MArray, MArrayStyle

class MArrayGreenStyle(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        arr = (
            MArray([10, 20, 30, 40], style=MArrayStyle.GREEN)
            .add_indexes()
            .add_label(Text("nums", font_size=24))
        )
        arr.move_to(ORIGIN)
        self.play(FadeIn(arr))
        self.wait(0.5)
